integrity: Self-contained proof and independently executable exact-rational checker included. No claim of external certification or definitive priority.
scientific_limitations: The exact joint factorial-moment formula is already published (da Silva, Jamshidpey and Tavare 2020, Equation 6), and the claimed novelty is limited to the all-pairs covariance asymptotic coefficient and critical exact parity and factorial scale. Historical priority may be affected by unknown equivalent analyses. Noncritical asymptotics fix theta,a,b and exclude theta=1; the critical finite-size signs require a,b distinct at least two; diagonal cases and parameter-uniform crossover are not addressed. The 2008 Latin-square paper was read at abstract level only. Independent validation not performed.
title: A singular covariance phase boundary for fixed-point-free Ewens permutations
